source_full_text: and beneath it was a large drinking-horn, Mounted with silver. Niels went closer to look at these, and saw that the horn had letters engraved on the silver rim when he took it down and turned it round, he found that the inscription was Whoever drinks the wine I hold can wield the sword that hangs above then let him use it for the right, And win a royal maiden's love.
target_trajectory: 在它下面有一只巨大的饮酒角，镶着银边。尼尔斯走近仔细查看，发现那角上刻着字母。
